title: In a cloud session, the brake pace number reads "n/a (cloud)", never 0
why: Owner, Nov 1 21:34 CST: "why would there be brake refusals when you are running on the cloud? that's specific to local sesions." Rule reports-batch-pace-numbers' fourth number reads only the local guard.log, and the load brake applies to local sessions only.
note: Fix: the pace-number reader prints "n/a (cloud)" for the brake number in a cloud session, and the rule text says so. Red first: a cloud fixture reports n/a (cloud), not 0; a local fixture with load-brake lines reports their count. Port: yes, the rule loads everywhere. Ready.
